company.name: Mirelo AI
company.shortDescription: Mirelo AI develops generative audio models and tools that create synchronized sound and music for video content.
company.description: Mirelo AI develops artificial intelligence models and software that generate synchronized sound and music for visual media. The company focuses on foundational generative audio models that analyze video and render sound effects, ambience, and musical compositions aligned to the timeline. Its technology underpins Mirelo Studio, a web application for scene-based audio generation and editing, and native plugins for video editors such as Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. Mirelo AI also offers APIs that allow developers, gaming platforms, and production pipelines to integrate video-to-audio and text-to-audio capabilities into their products. Its tools are used across use cases including content creation, AI-generated video, digital advertising, gaming, and cinematic post-production. By providing both an end-user studio and programmable interfaces, Mirelo AI supports creators and teams who need controllable, high-quality audio for video workflows.
